Good to Know

## Questions about getting in touch

**How do I book a meeting with DevEraXTech?**

Fill in the form on this page with your name, email, phone number, the service you need and a short message, and pick a preferred slot. You can also call +20 100 001 6216 or email deveraxtech@gmail.com.

**How fast will DevEraXTech reply?**

Most enquiries receive a reply within one business day. We are available every day from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Egypt time.

**What happens after I send the form?**

We read your message and reply, usually within one business day. If you picked a meeting time, we confirm it or suggest the nearest available slot. On the call we discuss your goals, content and timeline, then send a clear scope with milestones.

**What should I include in my message to DevEraXTech?**

Tell us what you want to build, who it is for, any websites you like, your ideal launch date and a rough budget if you have one. If you are not sure yet, a short description of your business is enough to start.
